chapter.heading: Psalm 70Prayer for Help against Persecutors.To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
chapter.v:
O God,
come quickly to save me;O Lord, come quickly to help me!

Let those
be ashamed and humiliatedWho seek my life;Let them be turned back and humiliatedWho delight in my hurt.

Let them
be turned back because of their shame and disgraceWho say, “Aha, aha!”

¶May all
those who seek You [as life’s first priority] rejoice and be glad in You;May those who love Your salvation say continually,“Let God be magnified!”

But I
am afflicted and needy;Come quickly to me, O God!You are my help and my rescuer;O Lord, do not delay.
